identity.record_key_policy: closed allowlist; a record carrying any other key fails the freeze
identity.answer_key_policy: closed denylist applied at every depth; a record naming any answer, grader, reference, rubric or solution key fails the freeze
identity.record_digest_input: the exact UTF-8 bytes of one JSONL record line including its terminating LF
identity.record_digests_stored_reason: each shard is byte-pinned by CORPUS_SHARD_DIGESTS.txt and each record's position is pinned by the declared canonical order, so every record's bytes are already pinned exactly. A second per-record list would only add a place to drift; the verifier recomputes record digests at verification time, which is where the contamination decisions are made.
identity.size_features_declared_on_record_reason: v1 bucketed on a generator-declared token estimate, which a record could misdescribe. v2 derives every structural feature from the model-visible payload, so a record cannot misdescribe its own size.
